privacyIntro.title: Introduction
privacyIntro.body: This draft explains how {{appName}} handles information when you set up a profile, prepare a solar panel cleaning request, or contact the business.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.body: The app saves your name, primary mobile number, optional alternate number, preferred language, and the details you provide for service requests. Booking details include the installation address, coordinates when you share them, and any instructions you add.

contactData.title: Customer Contact Information
contactData.body: Your saved name and mobile numbers are used to fill future booking requests. Each submitted request keeps the contact details you provided at submission.

location.title: Location Information
location.body: Each location lookup begins when you tap Use My Current Location during booking and allow foreground location access. You can enter an address manually. Captured coordinates are saved with the booking if you choose that location.

bookingData.title: Booking Information
bookingData.body: A saved request contains the service, booking reference, contact details, address, optional instructions, status, and submission time. You can review your requests in My Bookings.

use.title: How Information Is Used
use.body: The app uses your information to prefill forms, show your booking history, and remember your language. The business will use details it receives to review requests, locate the installation, and communicate about service.

storage.title: Data Storage
storage.body: This version stores profiles, language preferences, and booking requests on the device. Booking submission creates a local record. The business will define its storage and retention policy before connecting a backend.

sharing.title: Information Sharing
sharing.body: Using Google Maps opens the map service with the selected coordinates. Calls, WhatsApp, and websites are handled by the apps or services you open. The business may share relevant details with people coordinating or delivering service, subject to its final policy.

security.title: Data Security
security.body: Local data is subject to your device’s security and backup settings. The business will define and document safeguards for any future server-side processing.

rights.title: Customer Rights
rights.body: You can review your saved requests and correct your contact details in Profile. For questions about access, correction, or deletion of information held by the business, use its published contact details.

deletion.title: Account Deletion
deletion.body: The Delete Account screen explains the consequences and asks for confirmation. This version cannot send a deletion request. The business must approve a deletion and retention policy before connecting that service.

contact.title: Contact Information
contact.body: Use the business contact details published in the app for questions about service, privacy, or these terms.

policyUpdates.title: Policy Updates
policyUpdates.body: The business will review this draft and publish the applicable privacy policy before release. Refer to the approved policy for later changes.

termsIntro.title: Introduction
termsIntro.body: These draft terms describe the {{appName}} booking experience. The business will provide the approved terms before publication.

service.title: Description of Service
service.body: {{appName}} lets customers prepare requests for professional solar panel cleaning at the installation location.

requests.title: Booking Requests
requests.body: Submitting a request in this version records it on the device with a pending status. Keep the booking reference if you need assistance.

confirmation.title: Booking Confirmation
confirmation.body: The business must confirm a request before service is arranged. A pending record indicates that confirmation is still required.

serviceLocation.title: Service Location
serviceLocation.body: Provide the address of the solar installation and review any GPS location before submitting. Include directions that would help the team find the site.

responsibilities.title: Customer Responsibilities
responsibilities.body: Provide accurate contact and installation details. Coordinate access to the installation with the business and share relevant site conditions.

scheduling.title: Service Scheduling
scheduling.body: Scheduling depends on the installation location and the business’s availability. Arrange a suitable time with the business.

cancellation.title: Changes and Cancellation
cancellation.body: Contact the business to discuss changes or cancellation. The business will publish its applicable policy before release.

pricing.title: Pricing and Payment
pricing.body: Ask the business about pricing and payment arrangements before agreeing to service. The business will provide the applicable terms.

limitations.title: Service Limitations
limitations.body: The business will review access and site conditions when deciding whether it can provide the requested service.

communication.title: Communication
communication.body: Use the listed contact channels to reach the team. The business may use the contact details you provide to discuss your request.

termsUpdates.title: Changes to Terms
termsUpdates.body: The business will publish the approved terms and communicate later changes through its chosen channels.

external.title: External Services
external.body: The app opens the dialer, WhatsApp, Google Maps, or a configured website when you choose that action. The external app or service handles what happens after opening.
